```{r, rebase a transect's distances to its own pin}
rebase_to_pin <- function(topo_df) {
  pin_rows <- topo_df[grepl("pin", topo_df$Point_ID, ignore.case = TRUE), ]

  if (nrow(pin_rows) != 1) {
    stop("Expected exactly 1 pin row, found ", nrow(pin_rows),
         " for transect(s): ", paste(unique(topo_df$Transect_ID), collapse = ", "))
  }

  pin_dist <- pin_rows$Distance_AlongTransect_m[1]
  topo_df$Distance_AlongTransect_m <- topo_df$Distance_AlongTransect_m - pin_dist
  topo_df
}
```

```{r, load all four real topo files, restricted to thesis sampling transects}
# Transect_ID lowercased on load -- normalizes GallinasCreek's
# uppercase convention against everything else, once, here, rather
# than special-casing it downstream.
load_topo <- function(path) {
  readr::read_csv(path) |>
    mutate(Transect_ID = str_to_lower(Transect_ID)) |>
    filter(Transect_ID %in% c("xsa", "xsb"))   # drops xsc/xsd where present
}

giant_marsh_topo   <- load_topo("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\Savannah Thesis_BeccaFolder\\Linear Referencing\\GiantMarsh_06022025_LinRef.csv")


corte_madera_topo  <- load_topo("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\Savannah Thesis_BeccaFolder\\Linear Referencing\\CorteMadera_06162025_LinRef.csv")

san_pablo_topo      <- load_topo("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\Savannah Thesis_BeccaFolder\\Linear Referencing\\SonomaBaylands_06032025_LinRef.csv")

bucks_landing_topo <- load_topo("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\Savannah Thesis_BeccaFolder\\Linear Referencing\\GallinasCreek_06172025_LinRef.csv")

# Rebase EACH transect separately -- each has its own pin at its own
# position, confirmed different for every transect across all 4 sites.
topo_data_by_transect <- list(
  xsa = bind_rows(
    giant_marsh_topo    |> filter(Transect_ID == "xsa") |> rebase_to_pin() |> mutate(Site = "GiantMarsh"),
    corte_madera_topo   |> filter(Transect_ID == "xsa") |> rebase_to_pin() |> mutate(Site = "CorteMadera"),
    san_pablo_topo      |> filter(Transect_ID == "xsa") |> rebase_to_pin() |> mutate(Site = "SanPablo"),
    bucks_landing_topo  |> filter(Transect_ID == "xsa") |> rebase_to_pin() |> mutate(Site = "Buck'sLanding")
  ),
  xsb = bind_rows(
    giant_marsh_topo    |> filter(Transect_ID == "xsb") |> rebase_to_pin() |> mutate(Site = "GiantMarsh"),
    corte_madera_topo   |> filter(Transect_ID == "xsb") |> rebase_to_pin() |> mutate(Site = "CorteMadera"),
    san_pablo_topo      |> filter(Transect_ID == "xsb") |> rebase_to_pin() |> mutate(Site = "SanPablo"),
    bucks_landing_topo  |> filter(Transect_ID == "xsb") |> rebase_to_pin() |> mutate(Site = "Buck'sLanding")
  )
)

# CAUTION: xsa/xsb are shared labels across all four sites -- the list
# above bundles all four sites' xsa points together under one key.
# Fine as long as every downstream lookup filters by Site first (see
# the pmap below) -- if add_local_slope() is ever called without that
# Site-first filter, it WILL silently blend different sites' elevation
# profiles into one spline.
```

```{r, apply to the standard sediment pad distances}
pad_dists <- c(0.5, 2, 6, 12, 18, 24, 48)

slope_lookup <- transect_crosswalk |>
  mutate(Topo_Transect_ID = str_to_lower(Topo_Transect_ID)) |>
  filter(!is.na(Topo_Transect_ID))

slope_check <- pmap_dfr(
  list(slope_lookup$Site, slope_lookup$Tran, slope_lookup$Topo_Transect_ID),
  function(Site, Tran, Topo_Transect_ID) {
    topo_df <- topo_data_by_transect[[Topo_Transect_ID]]
    topo_df <- topo_df[topo_df$Site == Site, ]

    local_slope_and_elevation_at(topo_df, pad_dists) |>
      mutate(
        Site = Site,
        Tran = Tran,
        surveyed_min = min(topo_df$Distance_AlongTransect_m),
        surveyed_max = max(topo_df$Distance_AlongTransect_m),
        extrapolated = Dist < surveyed_min | Dist > surveyed_max
      ) |>
      relocate(Site, Tran)
  }
)

slope_check

# Written to disk so downstream files (e.g. a combined
# elevation+wind+slope file) can read this directly instead of
# re-deriving it from the topo files -- same "each covariate writes
# its own CSV" pattern elevation, veg, and wind already follow. This
# was a real gap before: slope_check only existed in memory.
readr::write_csv(slope_check, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\local_slope_thesis.csv")
```

```{r, extrapolated points -- flagged and kept, not dropped}
# DECISION: these rows stay in slope_check and in any downstream join
# -- extrapolated is a column, not a filter. Anyone using local_slope
# in a model or plot can choose to exclude, weight, or footnote these
# specific rows, but this file never removes them.
slope_check |>
  filter(extrapolated) |>
  select(Site, Tran, Dist, local_slope, surveyed_min, surveyed_max)
```

```{r, consistency check against All_Sites_Calculated -- all 4 sites}
all_sites_z <- readr::read_csv("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\All_Sites_Calculated (with z star).csv")

site_tran_code <- tribble(
  ~Site,           ~Tran, ~Transect_ID,
  "GiantMarsh",    "T1",  "G1",
  "GiantMarsh",    "T2",  "G2",
  "CorteMadera",   "T1",  "C1",
  "CorteMadera",   "T2",  "C2",
  "SanPablo",      "T1",  "S1",
  "SanPablo",      "T2",  "S2",
  "Buck'sLanding", "T1",  "B1",
  "Buck'sLanding", "T2",  "B2"
)

recorded_elev <- all_sites_z |>
  select(-any_of("Site")) |>  # drop the raw file's own Site column if present --
  # avoids a Site.x/Site.y collision after the join below. site_tran_code's
  # Site is the canonical spelling used everywhere else in the pipeline
  # (GiantMarsh/CorteMadera/SanPablo/Buck'sLanding), so it's the one kept.
  inner_join(site_tran_code, by = "Transect_ID") |>
  mutate(Dist = as.numeric(str_extract(Point_ID, "(?<=-)\\d+\\.?\\d*"))) |>
  group_by(Site, Tran, Dist) |>
  summarise(recorded_elevation_m = mean(Elevation_m, na.rm = TRUE), n_replicates = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Flags Buck'sLanding's unexpected 4th replicate here, as data, rather
# than silently averaging it in without comment.
recorded_elev |>
  filter(n_replicates != 3) |>
  select(Site, Tran, Dist, n_replicates)

slope_check |>
  left_join(recorded_elev, by = c("Site", "Tran", "Dist")) |>
  mutate(diff_m = fitted_elevation_m - recorded_elevation_m) |>
  select(Site, Tran, Dist, fitted_elevation_m, recorded_elevation_m, diff_m, extrapolated) |>
  arrange(Site, Tran, Dist)

# DECISION on the Buck'sLanding T2 / SanPablo T2 near-edge gap (Dist
# 0.5-12, non-extrapolated rows with diff_m > ~0.10): accepted as
# spline noise, not investigated further. Consistent with a
# field-level read on those two sites specifically -- both Ramped;
# GiantMarsh/CorteMadera, both Scarped, didn't show this pattern.
# Not smoothed over or silently dropped -- still visible in the table
# above via diff_m, just not treated as a bug requiring another fix.
```

```{r, transect level slope via Farris and Hogan paper comparison}

translope_raw = readr::read_csv("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\thesis_2025_translopefull.csv")

translope <- translope_raw |>

  mutate(
    Site = case_when(
      str_starts(Transect_ID, "B")  ~ "Buck'sLanding",
      str_starts(Transect_ID, "C")  ~ "CorteMadera",
      str_starts(Transect_ID, "S")  ~ "SanPablo",
      str_starts(Transect_ID, "G") ~ "GiantMarsh",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

edge_slope_thesis <- translope |>
  inner_join(site_tran_code, by = c("Site", "Transect_ID")) |>
  transmute(
    Site, Tran,
    edge_slope_max_deg = atan(Max_Slope / 100) * 180 / pi,
    edge_slope_avg_deg = atan(Avg_Slope / 100) * 180 / pi
  )

readr::write_csv(edge_slope_thesis, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\edge_slope_thesis.csv")
```
